newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 polypropylene imports seen at 750,000 T.
newsitem.headline: China '97 polypropylene imports seen at 750,000 T.

text.p: China is expected to import 750,000 tonnes of polypropylene in 1997, the China Chemical Industry News said on Tuesday.
China's domestic demand for polypropylene, a raw material used to make fibres and film is expected to reach 1.9 million tonnes in 1997, it said.
Domestic output is expected to reach 1.15 million tonnes in 1997, up by 100,000 tonnes compared with 1996, the newspaper said. The shortfall of 750,000 tonnes would have to be met by imports.
Current domestic production capacity stood at 1.247 million tonnes, it said.
